narrative_purpose: Illustrates the chapter's one clearly-labelled speculation: a magnetised mineral face holding onto molecules of a single handedness while their mirror forms drift away unattached.
subject: A magnified flat mineral surface running diagonally across the lower half of the frame, its face crystalline and faceted. Faint curved field lines thread through the mineral and arc out above it into the fluid. Settled onto the surface and adhering to it are about ten small molecular units, each drawn as a small central bead with three short arms angled the same way — all ten oriented identically, all the same colour. Drifting in the fluid above, not touching the surface and moving away from it, are about eight mirror-image units of the same construction but with their three arms angled the opposite way, in a contrasting colour.
scene: A close view of a mineral face immersed in dark still fluid, no wider context, the fluid filling the upper portion of the frame.
camera: A low oblique view along the mineral surface so both the adhering units on it and the drifting units above it are visible.
light: Cool faint illumination; the adhering units glow softly from within, the drifting mirror units are dimmer and cooler, and the mineral facets catch weak cyan edge highlights. The field lines are the faintest elements in the frame.
palette: Void-indigo fluid, the mineral in desaturated dark stone with cool facet highlights, the adhering single-handed units in cyan, the rejected mirror units in magenta as the scarce warm-side accent, field lines in barely-visible living teal.
style: Painterly speculative-chemistry plate in naturalist manner, hand-painted, restrained and slightly diagrammatic in arrangement.
detail_level: Crisp on the molecular units so their opposite handedness is unmistakable, mid detail on the mineral facets, the field lines and fluid very soft.
composition: Mineral surface entering from the lower left and running to the middle right, adhering units in a row along it, drifting units dispersed in the upper left, a plain dark area of fluid at the upper right for an overlaid callout.
consistency_notes: The two populations must be recognisably mirror images of one another — same parts, opposite arm handedness — and the sorting must read as complete: every unit on the surface one hand, every unit drifting away the other. No literal magnet imagery; the field is suggested by faint curved lines only.
